description:
EHR Central – a product of mHospital, Inc. – is an on-demand healthcare services platform that enables doctors to connect with service-seeking patients. Registering with EHR Central allows healthcare providers to connect with patients that are in search for a remote or in-person doctor consultation sessions. The choice remains with providers to accept or decline a job.

Working with EHR Central and mHospital enables healthcare practitioners to define flexible work hours as per their convenience. A provider may choose to accept remote-only jobs while another may accept house call jobs or in-person office sessions. Furthermore, one can accept a combination of two or all three types of jobs including telehealth, house call, and office-based sessions.

Apart from other benefits, global recognition is another notable advantage attained by providers registered with EHR Central by mHospital. They can provide services to patients located anywhere in the world. Thus, EHR Central ensures that geographical location is no longer a barrier in the way of healthcare provision.

The ability to rate patients and provide positive feedback on interactions with them enables doctors to reward their clients. Alternatively, one may also give negative feedback. Since patients can also rate doctors and share feedback, the doctors can identify the shortcomings in past appointments and improve the interactions in the upcoming ones.

Highly rated doctors are more likely to land jobs because patients can view the list of doctors in the descending order of their corresponding ratings. Thus, the rating is not only a source of motivation for high-performing doctors but a way to get more jobs as well.

Are you a certified healthcare provider? Join EHR Central and mHospital by signing up and register your practice today!

The Health Passport (HSE) will support healthcare staff to get to know the needs of the passport holder, enabling them to consider reasonable adjustments before any assessment, examination or treatment of a person. 
The App has an “Edit” and a “Read” function. The passport holder can enter information about themselves in the App, by selecting the Edit tab and choosing the section they wish to edit.

There is a “Prev/Next” section tab which allows you to go through the sections in the App.  
Once the person has finished click “Save and exit”.
All information is saved to the passport holders personal device and can be viewed by opening the app and clicking on the relevant tab.

title: uniVersa E-Health App
description:
*Exklusiv für alle Kunden der uniVersa Krankenversicherung a.G. mit einer Vollversicherung*

Die Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen ist künftig nicht mehr wegzudenken: Sie bietet viele Vorteile. Die verschiedenen digitalen Anwendungen werden unter dem Begriff E-Health zusammengefasst.

*E-Health bei der uniVersa - was ist das?*

Durch E-Health haben Sie immer und überall Zugriff auf Ihre Gesundheitsdaten – schnell und sicher. Außerdem können Sie Ihre Gesundheitsdaten einfach mit Arztpraxen, Apotheken und Krankenhäusern austauschen.

Zur E-Health-Welt gehören beispielsweise das E-Rezept und die elektronische Patientenakte (ePA).

Ab sofort ermöglichen wir Ihnen die Teilnahme am E-Rezept bei teilnehmenden Arztpraxen - 2026 stellen wir Ihnen dann die elektronische Patientenakte zur Verfügung.

Natürlich ist die Teilnahme für Sie vollkommen freiwillig.

*Das sind Ihre Vorteile:*

•	Mit dem Online Check-In können Sie sich in Ihrer Arztpraxis anmelden
•	Rezepte erhalten Sie ganz einfach digital – auch Folgerezepte
•	Medikamente bequem per App vorbestellen
•	Verordnungen jederzeit digital griffbereit in Ihrer uniVersa E-Health App
•	E-Rezepte können Sie direkt über die uniVersa RechnungsApp einreichen

*Wer kann die E-Health App nutzen?*

Wenn Sie bei uns privat krankenvollversichert sind, können Sie die uniVersa E-Health App verwenden.

Derzeit ist die Nutzung der uniVersa E-Health App nur für Versicherungsnehmer möglich. Wir arbeiten bereits daran, die Vorteile auch den mitversicherten Personen (z.B. Ehepartner oder Kinder) zur Verfügung zu stellen. 

*Was brauchen Sie dazu?*

•	Eine Registrierung für das uniVersa-Kundenportal
•	Ihre Krankenversichertennummer (KVNR)
•	Einen Personalausweis mit Online-Ausweisfunktion 
•	Die uniVersa E-Health App und die E-Rezept-App der gematik
•	Ein NFC-fähiges Smartphone

*Wie können Sie sich freischalten bzw. registrieren?*

1.	Melden Sie sich im uniVersa Kundenportal an. 

Sie haben noch keinen Account für das uniVersa-Kundenportal? Dann registrieren Sie sich jetzt unter www.universa.de/kundenportal

2.	Im Kundenportal können Sie sich über den Menüpunkt „E-Health“ zur Nutzung freischalten lassen. 

3.	Bitte registrieren Sie sich im Anschluss in Ihrer uniVersa E-Health App mit:

•	Personalausweis mit Online-Ausweisfunktion
•	Krankenversichertennummer (KVNR)
•	Geburtsdatum
•	Postleitzahl

*Ihre Meinung ist uns wichtig!*

Über Feedback im App-Store freuen wir uns sehr. Da wir dort nicht auf alle Anliegen antworten können, wenden Sie sich bitte bei Fragen und Problemen einfach direkt an uns.

*Wie können Sie Ihren Account sperren?*

Ihren Account können Sie über folgenden Link sperren: https://idp-core.rise-service.de/auth/realms/168140459/account/#/delete-account

Unser E-Health-Support-Team steht Ihnen Montag bis Freitag von 9 bis 17 Uhr mit Ausnahme der bundesweiten Feiertage unter der Telefonnummer +49 911 5307-3727 zur Verfügung. Sie erreichen uns auch unter versichertenhelpdesk-universa@pkv-epa.de. 

Hilfe: https://www.universa.de/e-health/hilfe/ 
Impressum: https://www.universa.de/impressum/ 
Datenschutzhinweise: https://www.universa.de/e-health/datenschutzerklaerung/ 
Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.universa.de/e-health/nutzungsbedingungen/

description:
Prescripto solves the core problems of teleconsultations like never before.

Before Prescripto: You are consulting over WhatsApp but wondering how to ask for payments. And then waiting for ages for the payment screenshot to arrive!

After Prescripto: After the consultation, you reply with a prescripto generated prescription link. As you know that the prescription can not be opened without paying, you move on to your next patient with peace of mind.

A. The fastest prescription writer ever made

1. You can simply type anything just like you do in WhatsApp

3. Search easily for any of your past prescriptions and copy it directly.
4. Other smart tools such as smart panel, Quick Rx etc.

You can also customize the theme, change the template to make it more professional-looking.


B. Your own platform

1. The patient sends you a message through WhatsApp (Business number). They may be your old patients who directly message you or for new patients, you can create a professional-looking e-clinic (auto-generated with registration) where new patients will send you a well-crafted message so that you can immediately decide whether to take the case or not.

3. Both e-clinic and booking widget can be translated into 10 Indian languages, can be embedded in your website (one line of code), can be sent to patients (as a link), and optionally can also be integrated with our patient-facing site myskinmychoice.com for free (that might give you a good number of new patients for free)

1. Every prescription is saved. You may search with any keyword within your past prescriptions such as patient name, disease name, medicine name, etc.

2. You may add a digital signature to the prescription

3. Patients get a money receipt with every prescription.

4. Before sending a request through e-clinic and before viewing your prescription, the patient must agree to the appropriate terms of online consultation.

title: Cardiology
description:
It's An Android Application That Present All Heart Diseases

Cardiology (from Greek καρδίᾱ kardiā, "heart" and -λογία -logia, "study") is a branch of medicine that deals with the disorders of the heart as well as some parts of the circulatory system. The field includes medical diagnosis and treatment of congenital heart defects, coronary artery disease, heart failure, valvular heart disease and electrophysiology. Physicians who specialize in this field of medicine are called cardiologists, a specialty of internal medicine. Pediatric cardiologists are pediatricians who specialize in cardiology. Physicians who specialize in cardiac surgery are called cardiothoracic surgeons or cardiac surgeons, a specialty of general surgery.

Although the cardiovascular system is inextricably linked to blood, cardiology is relatively unconcerned with hematology and its diseases. Some obvious exceptions that affect the function of the heart would be blood tests (electrolyte disturbances, troponins), decreased oxygen carrying capacity (anemia, hypovolemic shock), and coagulopathies.

title: Jardin Mental
description:
Jardin Mental est un journal personnalisable qui vous permet de rentrer toutes les informations utiles pour évaluer votre état de santé mentale, en suivre l’évolution, et comprendre ce qui influe dessus. Vous pouvez l’utiliser en autonomie pour apprendre à mieux vous connaître, mais c’est surtout un outil à partager avec le professionnel de santé qui vous suit, pour optimiser votre prise en charge en vous accompagnant dans l’amélioration de votre santé mentale et dans la gestion de votre trouble ou souffrances psychiques.
Grâce à un questionnaire quotidien qui vous demande d’évaluer des indicateurs personnalisés de votre santé mentale (symptômes, ressentis, comportement ou pensées), de noter les évènements marquants de votre journée, ou encore de renseigner vos prises de traitement, vous n’oublierez plus aucune information importante à relater lors des consultations avec les acteurs de votre parcours de soins psychiques (psychiatre, psychologue, psychothérapeute, infirmier, pair-aidant, éducateur spécialisé, etc…).
Jardin Mental est entièrement gratuit, anonyme, et aucune information personnelle n’est nécessaire pour l'utiliser. Personne ne peut accéder aux données que vous rentrez dans l’application, elles sont uniquement stockées sur votre téléphone (et ne sont donc pas sauvegardées ailleurs). C’est vous qui décidez si vous souhaitez les montrer à un professionnel de santé lors de votre consultation, ou de les lui envoyer directement par mail via l’application.
Jardin Mental est développée en continu avec des professionnels de santé (psychiatres, psychologues, infirmiers et pair-aidants) ainsi qu’avec les utilisateurs de l’application. Afin d’améliorer notre service au plus près de vos attentes, n’hésitez pas nous envoyer vos suggestions à jardinmental@frabique.social.gouv.fr ou via le bouton « Contribuer à l’application » que vous trouverez dans l’application. Laissez-nous vos coordonnées afin d’être recontacté(e) par notre équipe, dans le but de partager pleinement votre expérience utilisateur.
Dans « Mes entrées » : vous retrouverez votre questionnaire quotidien ou vous pouvez suivre vos indicateurs comme « anxiété, angoisse, moral, humeur, stress, mélancolie, tristesse, motivation, qualité du sommeil, libido, insomnie » ou des comportements. Vous pouvez aussi renseigner vos prises de traitement, tels que des antidépresseurs, en choisissant dans la liste préremplie ou en le personnalisant si ce n’est pas un médicament couramment prescrit par un médecin.
Grâce aux notes personnelles, renseignez tous les évènements et toutes les pensées de votre journée. En plus d’être un journal personnel, cela peut m’aider à comprendre si un évènement particulier influe sur le fait que je ne vais pas bien. Si ce n’est pas le cas, remplir régulièrement les notes personnelles vous permettra d’identifier d’autres causes, parfois plus discrètes, qui peuvent pourtant fortement influer sur votre bien-être (baisse de moral, crise d’angoisse, attaque de panique).
JardinMental propose aussi un exercice (les colonnes de Beck), fréquemment utilisé dans le cadre des thérapies comportementales et cognitives (TCC). Cet exercice permet d’analyser ses pensées automatiques (ou pensées dysfonctionnelles), en analysant leur cause et leurs conséquences, permettant ainsi une restructuration de la pensée. Nous vous recommandons de discuter de cet exercice lors d’une séance avec votre thérapeute.
Jardin Mental est un accompagnement dans votre rétablissement. En revanche, il ne saurait se substituer à une consultation, ne permet pas de réaliser un diagnostic médical (troubles de l’humeur, dépression, trouble anxieux, trouble bipolaire, trouble du comportement alimentaire, anorexie, boulimie, trouble paranoïaque, …) ou de contacter un professionnel de santé. En cas d’urgence psychiatrique (notamment en cas d’idées suicidaires), vous pouvez contacter les urgences ou les numéros d’assistance proposés dans l’application, rubrique « Parler à quelqu’un » dans le menu.

title: Basic Trauma Care (BTC)
description:
Op zoek naar een app die jou helpt bij het vinden van de juiste informatie over Basic Trauma Care (BTC)? Met deze app kun je gemakkelijk je geheugen opfrissen door stapsgewijs het protocol te doorlopen. Informatie is op ieder willekeurig moment binnen handbereik. Geen ingewikkelde zoekfuncties, maar een overzichtelijke app die er is om jou wegwijs te maken in het MARCH-protocol. Kom je niet uit het protocol? Geen probleem, de handelingen worden stapsgewijs beschreven in het trainingsgedeelte van de app.

title: Empower Physical Therapy
description:
Welcome to the Empower Physical Therapy App! Log on to access your personalized Home Exercise Program on your mobile device. 

Using this app, you can access your personalized Home Exercise Program with HD Instructional videos. On the 'Messages' tab, you can securely communicate with your Empower Physical Therapy provider. As you complete your exercises, we'll give you trophies and medals to celebrate your progress!

On the 'Awards' tab, you can track these items. Prefer a language other than English? Go to the 'More' tab and select 'Languages' to pick another language option. title: Intensive Care Logbook
description:
The LogICU App has been designed to produce the reports for doctors training in in for Intensive Care Units (ICU). The App allows you to collect patient, support and procedural data on your Android mobile device and to print the required reports.  The App has been tested by consultant and trainees in ICU in several hospitals in the UK. 

Check more detail and user guide here:  m-pax.net

If you want a more general logbook, you can find our Log4AS app
Full version:
https://market.android.com/details?id=tk.m_pax.log4asfull
Lite version:
https://market.android.com/details?id=tk.m_pax.log4aslite

Key features:
•	Intuitive data entry. Each time you add a record it is added to the existing set of records. It is possible to delete records, update and amend existing records at any time.
•	Access to the data held on the Android device can be password protected in case of loss or theft.
•	Data can be imported from the backup file, easy for switch or upgrade mobile phone
•	Backup has an easy to read and understand Excel spreadsheet format. 
•	The backup files can be displayed on your PC or Mac as an Excel spreadsheet and imported back on your phone if needed. No need for WiFi or GSM/3G access when entering and editing data or generating reports.
•	Reports are generated without the need for WiFi communication and can be viewed on your Android device screen for instant checking and reviewing. 
•	The report is stored in the mobile phone.
•	No need for a WiFi or GSM/3G connection in order to enter and save data or generate the reports. Data entered on each operation is saved in your mobile phone memory (security protected). You can also backup your operation data on the SD card on your phone.
•	You can email to yourself all the reports you have generated in one easy command so that they can be printed.
o	The only times you need access to WiFi or a GSM/3G network is when you want to email another computer for backup and printing.
•	The reports generated are:
•	Patient report
•	Specialty report
•	Diagnosis report
•	Organ report
•	Care-length report
•	Procedure report
•	Exposure report 
•	Comments report 
•	Patient outcome report
•	A simple search capability so as you can find particular records for review or editing.

title: Conn's Current Therapy
description:
“Try before you buy" - Download the FREE App, which includes sample content. In-App purchase required to unlock all content.

Designed for busy primary care specialists and other first-line care providers concise but in-depth format focuses on the most current diagnosis and treatment protocols for common complaints, acute diseases, and chronic illnesses with nearly 350 newly updated topics.

Trusted by clinicians for more than 75 years, Conn’s Current Therapy presents todad’s evidence-based information along with the personal experience and discernment of expert physicians. The 2024 edition is a helpful resource for a wide range of healthcare providers, including primary care physicians, subspecialists, and allied health professionals, providing current treatment information in a concise yet in-depth format. Nearly 350 topics have been carefully reviewed and updated to bring you state-of-the-art content in even the most rapidly changing areas of medicine.

Key Features
-  Offers personal approaches from recognized leaders in the field, covering common complaints, acute diseases, and chronic illnesses along with the most current evidence-based clinical management options.
- Follows a consistent, easy-to-use format throughout, with diagnosis, therapy, drug protocols, and treatment pearls presented in quick-reference boxes and tables for point-of-care answers to common clinical questions.
- Incorporates electronic links throughout the text that connect the reader to apps and clinical prediction tools that can easily be accessed in practice.
- Features thoroughly reviewed and updated information from multiple expert authors and editors, who offer a fresh perspective and their unique personal experience and judgment.
-  Provides current drug information thoroughly reviewed by PharmDs.
-  Features nearly 300 images, including algorithms, anatomical illustrations, and photographs, that provide useful information for diagnosis.
- This mobile application allows you to access all of the text, figures, and references from anywhere, anytime.

title: Infection Inspection
description:
Play as Wallace, a lone white blood cell, as you begin your quest to defend the heart from wave after wave of bacteria. You start off easy, with small groups of bacteria attacking from one point at a time, but soon the challenge begins. Engage in dramatic combat with coordinated bacterial attacks as you strive to last as long as possible.

Enjoy smooth camera motion and intuitive, responsive controls to help you on your way to a perfectly healthy body. Whether you choose to play defensive, and guard the heart from the two entrances, or offensive, and chase bacteria down as soon as the wave begins, you can be sure that Infection Inspection provides a fun, unique gaming experience.

A full, custom soundtrack is also included to heighten the drama. Throughout each game, the music becomes discreetly more intense until everything is too much and the body is finally overcome by bacteria. The score is more than fifteen minutes long, so you can be sure that, no matter how good you are, the soundtrack will create an exciting atmosphere for the entire duration of your game.

Download Infection Inspection now for free!

title: HelpMum Vaccination Tracker
description:
HelpMum Vaccination Tracking System is aimed at tackling vaccine related diseases and death in infants of 0 to 5 years old. It is a one of a kind app that helps mothers to save details of their children's birth and vaccination schedule so that they can receive prompt reminders as the date for the next vaccination approaches.

The app helps you to:
- Automatically generates your baby's vaccination appointment dates from childbirth till 9 years old
- Input your baby's vaccination details
- Receive reminders every time your baby's vaccination appointment is near to ensure you do not miss any dose
- Provides detailed information about the exact vaccine that should be received at every vaccination appointment.

These reminders have proven to be really helpful to mothers, especially those in remote rural areas, in keeping to their babies' vaccination schedule and this is significantly increasing immunisation outcomes in remote areas in Nigeria.

The vaccine details also ensures that mothers are better informed about the actual vaccine their baby would be receiving.

title: Vaccine Jo
description:
VaccineJo is a user-friendly application designed to help parents keep track of their babies' vaccination schedules based on the child’s date of birth and vaccine type.
By sending timely reminders via notifications, SMS, and emails, we ensure that no vaccination appointment is missed, keeping babies protected and healthy.

The vaccination schedule includes both free and privately obtained vaccines.

The system is designed to send notifications in advance based on the type of subscription. Additionally, parents can generate a comprehensive vaccination record as a downloadable PDF document. This record remains accessible without expiration.

VaccineJo uses phone, password, and OTP for login, while email, username, phone, and password are required for registration. The app collects phone numbers and emails to send SMS and email notifications, ensuring users receive timely reminders about upcoming vaccinations.

Besides reminders, the app also features expert-approved vaccine-related content provided by pediatricians. This section offers valuable insights into different vaccine types, possible side effects, and essential guidance for parents.

Our Mission
At VaccineJo, our mission is to support parents in Jordan by ensuring that no child misses a critical vaccination due to forgetfulness or lack of information. We aim to provide a seamless, reliable, and informative platform that helps parents stay on top of their child’s immunization schedule.

By leveraging technology and expert guidance, we strive to:
Enhance public health by ensuring timely vaccinations.
Empower parents with accurate, up-to-date vaccine information.
Reduce preventable diseases by making vaccination tracking effortless.

Through timely reminders, clear vaccine coverage details, and expert-backed resources, VaccineJo is committed to keeping Jordan’s children healthy and parents informed.

title: Vaccine
description:
Vaccine Preventable Livestock Diseases” an android app has been intended and
developed by the Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University
(GADVASU), to deepen the basic knowledge of the reader about livestock diseases and
specifically provide immediate information concerning diseases of farm animals against
which vaccines are existing. The focus of this app is on diseases of cattle, buffalo, pig
and sheep & goats, caused by viruses or bacteria, which are a threat to the livestock
owners in our country. This app has elaborated in detail about the disease, the disease
causative agents, host species being affected, ways of disease spread, clinical signs
helping in early disease suspicion, and disease management procedures, adoption of
which by the livestock owners could minimize the disease associated loss.

title: Vaccine Setu
description:
Vaccine Setu mobile application helps users discover the nearest vaccine centers in their district and provide navigation to those centers instantaneously. The application will help you list the vaccine centers around you based on age and vaccine availability and help navigate you to the desired vaccine center.

The application aims at providing free information with no ads or commercials. Vaccine Setu does not collect any personal information from its users for any commercial or monetary gain.

Key Features:
. Get vaccine centers in your district and discover them on the map.
. Filter the vaccine centers based on vaccine availability and age.
. Get detailed information on the vaccine type, dosage type, and vaccine quantity available in each of these centers until the coming week.
. Get a 10km radius circle to find which centers are inside it.
. Select the preferred vaccine center and get navigation from your current location

The data shown in the app is obtained from Co-WIN Public APIs. Hence the location information need not always be accurate.
A geocoding process is enabled in the app that will help to fetch location information for the centers having no location data received from the Co-WIN portal. 

So kindly be patient while the data is loaded, as it may take from a few seconds to a couple of minutes depending on the number of vaccine centers.

The sole purpose of my work is to contribute and help the community in these had times of Covid19. The app is new and not rigorously tested. So kindly be gentle with your comments. If you find any issue with the app functionality, do write to me. The bugs which are identified in the application will be resolved as early as possible. If there are any data-related issues, bring them to the Co-WIN Public APIs Github discussion portal.

Feel free to write to me if you wish to give feedback, collaborate, contribute data and intellect. Stay safe and get vaccinated :)

If we don't do it ourselves, no one does it.

The VaccineGo app is a tool that protects your family and reminds you in time for upcoming vaccinations.

title: DeHealth – AI health SuperApp
description:
DeHealth is a digital assistant for managing personal health, built on AI and blockchain technologies. The app consolidates user medical data, provides convenient access to records, analytics, recommendations, and general wellness features—without offering medical diagnoses or treatment. DeHealth supports users in achieving physical, emotional, and preventive well-being.
As part of the Google Play Health apps declaration, DeHealth's functionality covers the following categories: physical activity, nutrition, cycle and reproductive health, sleep, mental well-being, stress management, and general wellness. None of the implemented features are clinical in nature or used for diagnosis or treatment. Below is a specific description of how each category corresponds to the app’s functionality.

1. Activity and fitness:
Users receive tools to track physical activity, set personal fitness goals, get tips, and view progress through graphs. All information is general wellness content and is not intended for clinical use.

2. Nutrition and weight management:
The app allows users to log meals, hydration, weight, and receive general advice regarding nutrition and metabolic health. No dietary diagnostics or clinical assessment is included.

3. Period tracking:
DeHealth provides menstrual cycle tracking, symptom logging, and support for reproductive health, including PCOS. Predictions are based on user input and are not medical recommendations.

4. Sleep management:
Sleep functions include logging duration, post-sleep condition, viewing changes over time, and general sleep hygiene tips. The app does not analyze sleep phases or disorders.

5. Stress management, relaxation, mental acuity:
Users can access breathing exercises, relaxation and focus tools, and reflective journaling. All features are aimed at general wellness without psychological or psychiatric diagnosis.

6. Mental and behavioral health:
The app includes basic tools for self-assessment of emotional state, mood logging, and reflection. No functionality is intended for treatment, detection, or control of mental disorders.

7. Reproductive and sexual health:
The user can store and organize information about fertility, gynecological symptoms, and documents related to sexual health. Access to data is fully user-controlled. No clinical or diagnostic functions are included.

title: Score 4 Articulation: Speech
description:
Turn speech therapy practice into a fun and engaging game with Score 4 Articulation! Created by a speech-language pathologist, this innovative tool is perfect for achieving multiple trials of speech sounds, helping to improve speech skills. Whether you're a speech-language pathologist seeking an effective therapy tool or a parent looking for a fun way for your child to practice speech sounds at home, Score 4 Articulation is the perfect solution.

KEY FEATURES:

Engaging Gameplay: Enjoy the classic challenge of connecting four in a row, now with a twist! Each turn begins with practicing a speech sound, making articulation practice an integral part of the game.

Speech Mastery Through Play: During each turn, players can tap the word on the game piece to hear a pronunciation model before practicing it aloud. A visual counter tracks each repetition, encouraging the player to practice the word more frequently. This interactive approach motivates extensive practice, effectively refining the student's articulation skills.

Targeted Sound Practice: Choose from a variety of game boards, each focusing on different sounds including R (initial, vocalic, blends), S (initial, blends, final), L (initial, medial, blends), SH (initial, medial + final), CH (initial, final), J (initial, medial + final), and TH (voiceless). Target words have been meticulously selected by a speech-language pathologist, and a clear pronunciation model can be heard aloud by tapping on the image.

Multiple Modes and Levels: Challenge the computer in single-player mode or play against a friend, SLP, or parent in two-player mode. Select from easy to difficult levels to suit the student’s skill. If two students are practicing together in a group speech therapy session, they can each select a different target sound and play the game together, making group sessions more interactive and effective.

Rewards and Motivation: Achieve four in a row to win and celebrate by coloring in three stars! Additionally, the visual counter rewards every 10 repetitions with a star or diamond, motivating children to practice more and track their progress. These fun visual rewards encourage continued play and learning.

Research-Based Effectiveness: Research suggests that massed practice, with many repetitions in a short period, enhances speech sound acquisition and motor learning (Maas et al., 2008; Bislick et al., 2012). This game leverages this principle to help children improve their speech more effectively.

With Score 4 Articulation, speech practice is no longer a chore—it’s a game! Help your child or students master their speech sounds while having fun. Download now and start practicing!
